acting_overall.note: High reject-both rate indicates a provider/direction ceiling, not merely a voice-ranking problem.

interpretation.identity_is_not_the_problem: The previous ABX campaign produced 46/46 correct identity matches in panic and tenderness.
interpretation.current_edge_strength: Neutral and long-form narration are substantially stronger than explicit acting probes.
interpretation.current_edge_weakness: Panic, mystery and wonder each had only 1 accepted winner among 7 comparisons; polite threat produced no winner.
interpretation.next_test: Before adding another production provider, test whether rate/pitch/volume direction presets materially improve hard emotions on a small representative voice set. If not, benchmark a provider with native expressive controls.
